# Lieflat Charts attribution

Gate 15A adapts the **L1 Launch Fan** implementation from `larashero3-dotcom/lieflat-charts` for the Explore surface.

- Source: `templates/lupi-gallery.html` (`1 · launch fan`)
- License: **PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0**
- License terms: https://polyformproject.org/licenses/noncommercial/1.0.0/
- Upstream repository: https://github.com/larashero3-dotcom/lieflat-charts

The upstream template is used here for a noncommercial research / experiment build. Before any commercial use of Frontier Radar, re-check and obtain any license required for this adapted code.

The adapted Explore implementation preserves the L1 data contract: one spoke per record, emergence time determines the start position, time marks continue toward the present, and the primary node size encodes the current value (Frontier Radar Global Score).
